chunks: Verily men and women who have come to submission, men and women who are believers, men and women who are devout, truthful men and truthful women, men and women with endurance, men and women who are modest, men and women who give alms, men and women who observe fasting, men and women who guard their private parts, and those men and women who remember God a great deal, for them God has forgiveness and a great reward.
ai.seo_question: What are the key virtues of men and women promised forgiveness and great reward in the Quran?
ai.summary: Known as the Verse of the Virtues (Ayat al-Fadha'il), this verse is pivotal in Shia scholarship for establishing the spiritual equality of men and women, often cited to support the status of Fatima al-Zahra (SA) as the archetype of these virtues. It emphasizes that divine reward is contingent upon the active practice of specific moral and ritual disciplines, such as constant remembrance (Dhikr) and chastity, rather than mere gender or lineage.
